entities.name: Ioane I, Prince of Mukhrani
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ioane was a Georgian diplomat and military commander. As the head of the Mukhrani branch of the royal Bagrationi dynasty of Kartli, he was Prince (batoni) of Mukhrani and ex officio commander of the Banner of Shida Kartli and Grand Master of the Household (msakhurtukhutsesi) at the court of Georgia from 1778 to 1801.
